run_audiodec_streaming: run a real-time audio codec streaming pipeline with GPU or CPU device assignment
run_audiodec_with_model: run the AudioDec streamer with a specified model like libritts_sym or libritts_v1
run_audiodec_gpu: run the AudioDec streaming demo with separate CUDA devices for transmitter and receiver
run_audiodec_cpu: run the AudioDec streaming demo on CPU by setting tx_cuda and rx_cuda to -1
run_audiodec_filedump: run the AudioDec streamer with file dump enabled to save input and output WAV files
